text:
anya: brief heads-up — rolled hot-prune-v4 to a 10-host canary this morning. p95/p99 improved, small cold regressions on <1% of shards.

ops-bot: deploy: hot-prune-v4 -> helix-canary (10 hosts) at 2026-05-05T09:10:00Z

drew: quick numbers (canary vs baseline, matched slice, 4h): p50 45ms->43ms, p95 230ms->160ms, p99 480ms->340ms, token-cost -6%.

kai: good reductions. where did cold regressions show up?

anya: mostly on shards with extreme long-context bursts and near-zero KV reuse. cold p5 +30-50ms.

sre_lead: any errors/5xx? I scanned SLOs — stable. saw 0.8% rise in cb trips for shard shd-117, rolled that shard back.

drew: mitigation plan: add per-shard hold_ms override + a conservative shard-label mode. rollout plan: merge PR, run 48h extended canary (50 hosts), then global flip if clean.

anya: PR created: https://git.internal/r/pr/4701 — includes metrics for eviction_rate and protected_warmset_size.

kai: please add bench command to the ticket so oncall can reproduce the regressed case.

anya: bench command added to ticket RT-4810. rollback is single flag: features.hot_prune.enabled=false. will post follow-up after extended canary. :rocket:
